name: GridScan-TS-TW
title: Grid Scan
description: WebGL component rendering a 3D perspective grid with animated scanning lines. Optionally detects faces via webcam and responds to face position, gyroscopic input, or mouse movement. Includes post-processing bloom and chromatic aberration…
use: You need a tech-forward, sci-fi aesthetic for backgrounds or hero sections, especially with optional face tracking for…
avoid: Webcam access is unavailable, performance is critical, or users have photosensitivity concerns.
a11y: Primarily visual scanning effect; face detection is decorative. No keyboard alternative or prefers-reduced-motion guard.
